I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. It's a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant, so it's easy to tune. That keeps the loop at about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's 5 per second limit. I haven't run the test, since it hits the live sandbox.

If other tests in the suite also call the sandbox, they may need the same spacing. Running them in parallel would also push the combined rate over the limit.
